body: NFRD PRIMARY SLICE READY FOR CHIEF REVIEW. The bounded external fetch materially improved the intake record in docs/design/nfrd-primary-source-inventory.md. It is a documented Derivation, not raw stimulus bytes. (2) The Oregontrail/Baseball workbook has 113 distinct IDs, exactly matching both 113-file transcript sets. The README claim of 116 is stale and no longer Unknown. (3) All 458 released transcripts exceed 500 bytes. A bounded non-textual check of the smallest Baseball file found 130 tokens and substantive source-vocabulary overlap, so the paper's 9.4% technical loss does not manifest as empty released rows; the remaining Unknown is upstream selection into the released 229. No participant language, recall audio, or survey free text entered git. Bead bd-01M17FAGN83C3ZT2VZ2VKHWTYJ is back in review. Proposed next action after your disposition: make Baseball the first Diagnostic source-to-recall court, keeping source/participant bytes external and splitting participants before any model tuning; Sherlock remains the later cleanup-sensitivity control.
